description: Expanded deterministic COA/Waiver-aligned decision matrix for the Enhanced Patrol BVLOS Site Assessment app. This matrix is intentionally conservative and should be reviewed against the final COA/Waiver, CONOPS, risk matrix, operations manual, and current FAA authorization before operational reliance.

rules.label: Site Name / ID
rules.rationale: A site-specific record cannot be approved without a unique site identifier.
rules.failReason: Site Name / ID is required before approval.
rules.correctiveAction: Enter a unique site name or site identifier.

rules.label: Site location
rules.rationale: The operational volume, nearby facilities, airspace, and ground risk cannot be evaluated without site location data.
rules.failReason: Site address or coordinates are required before approval.
rules.correctiveAction: Enter an address or capture/enter site coordinates.

rules.label: Assessment Date
rules.rationale: The assessment must be tied to a date for currency, reassessment scheduling, and audit traceability.
rules.failReason: Assessment date is required before approval.
rules.correctiveAction: Enter the assessment date.

rules.label: Assessed By
rules.rationale: The assessment must identify who performed the site evaluation.
rules.failReason: Assessor name is required before approval.
rules.correctiveAction: Enter the person who completed the site assessment.

rules.label: RPIC Reviewing
rules.rationale: A responsible RPIC review entry is required before the site can be used operationally.
rules.failReason: RPIC review entry is required before approval.
rules.correctiveAction: Enter the RPIC responsible for reviewing the assessment.

rules.label: Launch Method
rules.rationale: Launch method determines whether dock, tactical, or both sets of controls apply.
rules.failReason: Launch method is required before approval.
rules.correctiveAction: Select Tactical Deployment, Dock Deployment, or Both.

rules.rationale: The site must be evaluated against the airspace class and applicable authorization limits.
rules.failReason: Airspace classification has not been confirmed.
rules.correctiveAction: Confirm and document the site airspace classification.

rules.rationale: Nearby aviation facilities drive notification, coordination, and airspace-risk evaluation.
rules.failReason: Distance to nearest airport/heliport has not been documented.
rules.correctiveAction: Document the distance to the nearest airport or heliport.

rules.sourceSection: All airports/heliports/ag/military facilities within 3 NM identified
rules.rationale: All nearby facilities must be identified before required notifications and risk controls can be validated.
rules.failReason: Nearby aviation facilities within 3 NM have not been identified.
rules.correctiveAction: Identify and document all airports, heliports, agricultural operations, and military installations within 3 NM.

rules.rationale: Required facility notifications must be complete before site authorization.
rules.failReason: Required notification letters have not been prepared/sent.
rules.correctiveAction: Prepare, send, and document required notification letters.

rules.rationale: TFR exposure can restrict or prohibit operations.
rules.failReason: TFR review has not been completed.
rules.correctiveAction: Review TFR activity and document no operational conflict or required limitation.

rules.rationale: NOTAMs can affect site availability, airspace restrictions, or operational constraints.
rules.failReason: NOTAM review has not been completed.
rules.correctiveAction: Review NOTAMs and document no operational conflict or required limitation.

rules.rationale: A site cannot be approved when unresolved special-use, restricted, or prohibited airspace conflicts exist.
rules.failReason: Restricted, prohibited, or special-use airspace conflict has not been cleared.
rules.correctiveAction: Resolve airspace conflict or mark the site not approved.

rules.sourceSection: Site within waiver-authorized airspace and altitude limits
rules.rationale: The site cannot be approved if it is outside authorized operating limits.
rules.failReason: Site has not been confirmed within waiver-authorized airspace and altitude limits.
rules.correctiveAction: Verify the site and planned altitude are within the COA/Waiver operating limits.

rules.rationale: The operational area must be bounded before containment, access control, and ground-risk exposure can be assessed.
rules.failReason: Property boundaries have not been confirmed.
rules.correctiveAction: Confirm site boundaries using survey, plat, client information, or approved site map.

rules.rationale: Controlled access reduces non-participant exposure and supports ground-risk mitigation.
rules.failReason: Controlled access has not been verified.
rules.correctiveAction: Verify gates, fencing, security controls, signage, or equivalent access controls.

rules.rationale: Non-participant notification signage may be a required operational mitigation at certain sites.
rules.failReason: Signage plan for non-participant notification has not been identified.
rules.correctiveAction: Identify signage or alternate non-participant notification controls.

rules.rationale: A client POC supports access control, local notifications, and operational coordination.
rules.failReason: Client POC for property access and notifications has not been identified.
rules.correctiveAction: Identify and document client POC contact details.

rules.rationale: Shielding classification and operating limits require documented shielding features.
rules.failReason: Potential shielding features have not been identified.
rules.correctiveAction: Identify and document buildings, terrain, containers, berms, trees, or other shielding features.

rules.rationale: Shielded BVLOS limits depend on validated shielding height.
rules.failReason: Shielding heights have not been measured or validated.
rules.correctiveAction: Measure or validate shielding heights and document the basis.

rules.rationale: The aircraft must remain vertically contained inside the assessed operational volume.
rules.failReason: Vertical containment has not been validated.
rules.correctiveAction: Validate vertical containment and document supporting shielding/altitude limits.

rules.rationale: The aircraft must remain laterally contained inside the assessed operational volume.
rules.failReason: Lateral containment has not been validated.
rules.correctiveAction: Validate lateral containment and update geofence/route if needed.

rules.sourceSection: Unshielded segments within allowable limits or VO requirement triggered
rules.rationale: Unshielded segments require additional operational controls or program review.
rules.failReason: Unshielded segments have not been resolved or marked for VO/control requirements.
rules.correctiveAction: Document unshielded segment limits and required VO/procedural controls.

rules.sourceDocument: Site Assessment App / Lost Link / CONOPS
rules.sourceSection: Emergency descent paths remain within containment
rules.rationale: Contingency procedures must not create flight outside the assessed operational volume.
rules.failReason: Emergency descent paths have not been validated within containment.
rules.correctiveAction: Validate emergency descent paths within the assessed containment volume.

rules.rationale: Operating conditions differ for shielded, non-shielded, or mixed sites.
rules.failReason: Shielded/non-shielded classification has not been documented.
rules.correctiveAction: Document whether the site is shielded, non-shielded, or mixed by segment.

rules.rationale: A defined launch zone is required to manage takeoff, recovery, and local ground risk.
rules.failReason: Launch zone has not been identified.
rules.correctiveAction: Identify and document the launch zone.

rules.rationale: Pre-designated launch and recovery areas support predictable operations and emergency response.
rules.failReason: Launch/recovery areas have not been pre-designated.
rules.correctiveAction: Pre-designate and document launch/recovery areas.

rules.rationale: A safe landing zone is required for normal recovery and contingency management.
rules.failReason: Landing zone has not been confirmed safe and accessible.
rules.correctiveAction: Confirm and document a safe and accessible landing zone.

rules.rationale: Emergency landing zones support contingency operations and mitigate ground risk.
rules.failReason: Emergency landing zones have not been identified.
rules.correctiveAction: Identify emergency landing zones within containment.

rules.rationale: OOP/OOMV exposure must be identified before mitigation and operating conditions can be determined.
rules.failReason: OOP/OOMV exposure zones have not been evaluated.
rules.correctiveAction: Identify OOP/OOMV exposure zones and risk level.

rules.rationale: Ground-risk mitigations are required for operational approval.
rules.failReason: Ground risk mitigations have not been documented.
rules.correctiveAction: Document altitude, time-of-day, corridor avoidance, PRS, access-control, or other mitigations.

rules.rationale: High-risk sites require mitigation or program review before operational use.
rules.failReason: Overall site risk is marked High.
rules.correctiveAction: Reduce risk through mitigation or escalate for program-manager review.

rules.rationale: High OOP/OOMV exposure requires mitigation or higher-level review.
rules.failReason: OOP/OOMV exposure is marked High Risk.
rules.correctiveAction: Reduce OOP/OOMV exposure or escalate for program-manager review.

rules.rationale: C2 validation must be acceptable before the site can be approved for operations.
rules.failReason: C2 validation must be PASS before approval.
rules.correctiveAction: Complete C2 validation and resolve failed or conditional results.

rules.rationale: Remote operations require verified operational communications between control locations and field personnel.
rules.failReason: ROC/TOC communications have not been tested.
rules.correctiveAction: Test and document ROC/TOC communications.

rules.rationale: If applicable, Authorized Ground Personnel communications support tactical launch/recovery and local risk controls.
rules.failReason: Authorized Ground Personnel communications have not been tested or marked not applicable.
rules.correctiveAction: Test AGP communications or document why they are not applicable.

rules.sourceSection: Dock network and sensor connectivity verified
rules.rationale: Dock operations require verified dock network/sensor connectivity.
rules.failReason: Dock network and sensor connectivity has not been verified or marked not applicable.
rules.correctiveAction: Verify dock network/sensor connectivity or document why dock controls do not apply.

rules.rationale: Route obstacles must be mapped to validate safe route, RTH, and emergency procedures.
rules.failReason: Obstacles have not been mapped along the intended route.
rules.correctiveAction: Map and document obstacles along the intended route.

rules.rationale: Wires and cables are critical collision hazards for low-altitude BVLOS routes.
rules.failReason: Wires/cables have not been evaluated.
rules.correctiveAction: Evaluate and document power, comms, trolley, or other cables near the route.

rules.rationale: The geofence must cover the operational area before containment can be relied on.
rules.failReason: Geofence coverage has not been confirmed.
rules.correctiveAction: Verify geofence covers the full operational area.

rules.sourceSection: Geofence matches property lines / controlled access perimeter + max altitude
rules.rationale: Geofence configuration must align with assessed property and altitude boundaries.
rules.failReason: Geofence/property/altitude alignment has not been confirmed.
rules.correctiveAction: Align and verify geofence boundaries, controlled-access perimeter, and maximum altitude.

rules.sourceDocument: Site Assessment App / Lost Link / CONOPS
rules.sourceSection: RTH path avoids obstacles and stays within containment
rules.rationale: RTH must not route the aircraft into obstacles or outside containment.
rules.failReason: RTH containment and obstacle avoidance have not been confirmed.
rules.correctiveAction: Validate RTH path, obstacle clearance, and containment.

rules.sourceDocument: Site Assessment App / Lost Link / CONOPS
rules.sourceSection: RTH does not allow deviation outside operational volume
rules.rationale: Lost-link/RTH behavior must remain within the operational volume.
rules.failReason: RTH deviation outside the operational volume has not been ruled out.
rules.correctiveAction: Update RTH/lost-link configuration or route/geofence to prevent deviation outside the operational volume.

rules.rationale: Conformance monitoring supports detection of route/geofence deviations.
rules.failReason: Conformance monitoring/alerts have not been confirmed functional.
rules.correctiveAction: Verify conformance monitoring and alerts.

rules.rationale: Annotated site imagery documents geofences, NFZs, shielding features, and operational volume.
rules.failReason: Detailed annotated site image has not been attached.
rules.correctiveAction: Attach annotated site image with geofence, NFZ, shielding, heights, and operational volume.

rules.sourceDocument: Site Assessment App / Flight Path Validation
rules.rationale: Preplanned waypoints are required to validate route containment and risk exposure.
rules.failReason: Routes have not been preplanned with waypoints.
rules.correctiveAction: Create and document waypoint-based route plan.

rules.sourceDocument: Site Assessment App / Flight Path Validation
rules.rationale: The planned route must remain inside the validated containment volume.
rules.failReason: Entire route has not been validated inside containment.
rules.correctiveAction: Validate route containment or revise route/geofence.

rules.sourceDocument: Site Assessment App / Flight Path Validation
rules.rationale: Planned altitude must be documented to compare against shielding, containment, and authorization limits.
rules.failReason: Planned altitude has not been documented.
rules.correctiveAction: Document planned altitude in feet AGL.

rules.sourceDocument: Site Assessment App / Flight Path Validation
rules.sourceSection: No exposure to unvalidated open airspace
rules.rationale: Site approval depends on the route avoiding unvalidated open-airspace exposure.
rules.failReason: Exposure to unvalidated open airspace has not been ruled out.
rules.correctiveAction: Validate or revise route to remove unvalidated open-airspace exposure.

rules.sourceSection: Emergency descent and landing routes validated
rules.rationale: Emergency paths must be validated to remain within containment and avoid ground hazards.
rules.failReason: Emergency descent and landing routes have not been validated.
rules.correctiveAction: Validate emergency descent and landing routes.

rules.sourceSection: Flight Risk Assessment completed and documented
rules.rationale: The Flight Risk Assessment is required for decision traceability and approval.
rules.failReason: Flight Risk Assessment is not documented.
rules.correctiveAction: Complete and attach/document the Flight Risk Assessment.

rules.rationale: Annotated maps document operational volume, geofences, NFZs, shielding, and ground-risk areas.
rules.failReason: Annotated site map screenshot has not been attached/documented.
rules.correctiveAction: Attach annotated site map screenshot.

rules.rationale: A site cannot be approved without an overall risk assignment.
rules.failReason: Overall site risk level has not been assigned.
rules.correctiveAction: Assign Low, Medium, or High overall site risk.

rules.rationale: Documented mitigations are required to justify operational conditions.
rules.failReason: Risk mitigations have not been documented.
rules.correctiveAction: Document risk mitigations.

rules.sourceSection: Unresolved risks flagged with follow-up actions
rules.rationale: Unresolved risks must be closed, mitigated, or accepted by appropriate authority.
rules.failReason: Unresolved risks have not been documented as resolved, mitigated, or requiring follow-up.
rules.correctiveAction: Document unresolved risks and required follow-up actions, or mark N/A.

rules.rationale: Approved sites require a scheduled reassessment date.
rules.failReason: Biannual reassessment date has not been scheduled.
rules.correctiveAction: Schedule and document biannual reassessment date.

rules.rationale: Operators must know which changes trigger reassessment.
rules.failReason: Conditions requiring reassessment have not been identified.
rules.correctiveAction: Identify reassessment triggers such as infrastructure, staging, C2, route, access-control, or construction changes.

rules.label: Property boundaries
rules.rationale: Photo evidence supports property boundary verification.
rules.failReason: Property boundary photo evidence is missing.
rules.correctiveAction: Add property boundary photo evidence.

rules.label: Access control
rules.rationale: Photo evidence supports access-control verification.
rules.failReason: Access-control photo evidence is missing.
rules.correctiveAction: Add access-control photo evidence.

rules.label: Shielding features
rules.rationale: Photo evidence supports shielding/containment classification.
rules.failReason: Shielding feature photo evidence is missing.
rules.correctiveAction: Add shielding feature photo evidence.

rules.label: Launch zone
rules.rationale: Photo evidence supports launch-zone assessment.
rules.failReason: Launch zone photo evidence is missing.
rules.correctiveAction: Add launch zone photo evidence.

rules.label: Emergency landing zone
rules.rationale: Photo evidence supports emergency landing zone verification.
rules.failReason: Emergency landing zone photo evidence is missing.
rules.correctiveAction: Add emergency landing zone photo evidence.

rules.label: Detailed annotated site image
rules.rationale: Annotated site image supports geofence, NFZ, shielding, and operational-volume review.
rules.failReason: Detailed annotated site image is missing.
rules.correctiveAction: Add the detailed annotated site image.

conditions.text: Operate only within the assessed site, documented route, mapped geofence, and approved operational volume.
RPIC must verify airspace status, NOTAMs, TFRs, weather, aircraft status, crew readiness, and site conditions before each operational period.
C2 link health, telemetry continuity, command response, and applicable video-feed stability must be confirmed before launch and monitored during flight.
Lost-link, RTH, emergency descent, and recovery procedures must remain inside the assessed containment area.
Emergency landing and recovery areas documented in the assessment must remain available and free of new hazards.
Stop operations and reassess the site if ground-risk exposure, access control, RF/C2 conditions, obstacles, construction, route geometry, or shielding conditions materially change.
The site must be reassessed no later than the documented biannual reassessment date.
Nearby airport/heliport/facility notifications must be complete and current before operations.
Shielded operations must remain within validated shielding height and documented lateral containment.
Non-shielded operations require documented ground-risk mitigation, containment, emergency landing options, and any required VO or procedural controls.
Dock operations require verified dock pad condition, network/sensor connectivity, and secured launch/recovery area before use.
Tactical deployment requires Authorized Ground Personnel to verify launch surface, clearances, communications, and local ground risk before launch.
OOP/OOMV exposure controls documented in this assessment must be in place during the entire operation.
Medium-risk site mitigations must be briefed, documented, and verified by the RPIC before each flight.
